これに伴い、新たなキャラクターを選考するお客さま投票を本日9月8日15時からスタートしました🎉
最も多くの票を獲得した候補を新たなイメージキャラクターとして採用し、Suicaを導入した記念日である11月18日に発表します🎊

↓↓↓お客さま投票の特設サイトはこちら↓↓↓

Meet STONKSCREENER a live market intelligence dashboard built for the StonkFun ecosystem.

What it does:

1) Surfaces trending launches under 4 hours old, filtered by real volume and market cap

2) Tracks KOL traction from 500+ wallets scraped from Kolscan, plus top traders from across the ecosystem

3) Crowns the "King of Stonks" when a fresh launch crosses $20K market cap near its peak with at least 50 holders

4) Shows a live activity timeline of recent buys and sells from tracked wallets

5) Lets you build a watchlist with optional audio alerts when new Kings appear

6) Flags risk signals like low holder count, concentrated supply, and thin liquidity

7) Includes token detail pages, market stats, newest launches, top movers, sparklines, and a customizable homepage layout

8) Refreshes data every few seconds so you are not
watching stale charts

The goal is simple: find the next mover before the rest of the timeline catches on.

Try it at stonkscreener.fun
